storyline.real: Häkkinen leads from pole, 3.3 s clear after 22 laps. At the first stops on lap 27 Ferrari give Schumacher the bigger fill for a longer middle stint, while Häkkinen runs with a damaged splitter and loses about 2 s to a brief engine cut-out. Häkkinen makes his second stop on lap 44; Schumacher stays out four more laps, rejoins ahead after his lap-48 stop and wins by 1.168 s.

eras.briefing: Imola, 2000. Häkkinen took pole and leads you by 3.3 s after 22 laps; you run Schumacher in the Ferrari. Two refuelling stops each: get the fill and the timing right and come out of the second stops in front.
